description: This file defines utility structures, enums, and functions related to gateway environment management, version handling, and command resolution within an OpenClaw-based application. It includes Semver comparison, environment checks, command execution, and version installation logic.

classes.name: Semver
classes.description: A lightweight semantic versioning helper for major.minor.patch versions with comparison and parsing capabilities.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a Semver object, handling prefixes and prerelease suffixes.

methods.name: compatible(with:)
methods.description: Checks if the current Semver is compatible with a required Semver based on major version and minimum version.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks the current gateway environment, returning status with details on node and gateway versions.

methods.name: resolveGatewayCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command to start the gateway, considering environment and configuration, returning command and status.

methods.name: installGlobal
methods.description: Installs the OpenClaw gateway globally using npm, pnpm, or bun, with status updates.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayVersionOutput
methods.description: Normalizes the output string from gateway version commands for parsing.

methods.name: readGatewayVersion
methods.description: Reads the version of the gateway binary by executing '--version' and parsing the output.

methods.name: readLocalGatewayVersion
methods.description: Reads the local project’s gateway version from package.json.
